title: Intro: Dawn of a New Era
statementMd:
Dear friends from across China, welcome to Shenyang! As the problem setters, along with the entire staff, we are deeply honored to have all of you here to enjoy a well-prepared event and witness the ninth consecutive year that Northeastern University (NEU) has hosted the ICPC Shenyang Regional Contest.

The past years have been challenging for most individuals. Human society underwent the COVID-19 pandemic, yet we fought against it and triumphed. Humanity continues to be tested when it seems like the Night Howlers have eroded some people's minds. And for the lovely university where we are currently situated, it has just successfully concluded its centennial celebration, turning over a new page for the next century. So, those are what inspired us to name this intro problem. We sincerely hope one can strive constantly for dreams rather than being willing to become the tears of the times. We also hope one can heal the world with new-age technologies, not to steer our civilization to a sunset!

As an integral part of Northeastern University's centennial celebration, the drone display utilized various colors to illuminate the night sky, creating pieces of stunning aerial artwork. In the intro problem, you are going to meet with a seemingly NP-hard task related to it.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1c85a967bb6d024ad1abc1fb3c59f98f15884192.png) Drone Display by Northeastern University

Suppose that there are 𝑛n scenes in the drone display. The palette of each scene can be described by a set of integers identifying different colors, and we say the *main color* of a scene is the color with the largest integer in its palette.

The drone operator intends to arrange the orders of the scenes. For each pair of **adjacent** scenes after the reordering, if the main color of the previous scene is one of the colors present in the palette of the following scene, a *transition* will be contributed. Can you help construct an arrangement of scenes such that the number of transitions is maximized?

More formally, let 𝑆𝑖Si be the set of integers which describes the palette of the 𝑖i-th scene. You need to construct a permutation 𝑝1,𝑝2,…,𝑝𝑛p1,p2,…,pn such that ∑𝑛−1𝑖=1[max{𝑆𝑝𝑖}∈𝑆𝑝𝑖+1]∑i=1n−1[max{Spi}∈Spi+1] is maximized among all the permutations of length 𝑛n, where [max{𝑆𝑝𝑖}∈𝑆𝑝𝑖+1][max{Spi}∈Spi+1] is 11 when max{𝑆𝑝𝑖}∈𝑆𝑝𝑖+1max{Spi}∈Spi+1 and 00 when max{𝑆𝑝𝑖}∉𝑆𝑝𝑖+1max{Spi}∉Spi+1.

Recall that a permutation of length 𝑛n is a sequence of 𝑛n integers in which every integer from 11 to 𝑛n appears exactly once.

## Input

The first line contains an integer 𝑛n (2≤𝑛≤1052≤n≤105), denoting the number of scenes in the drone display.

In the 𝑖i-th of the next 𝑛n lines, an integer 𝑚𝑖mi (𝑚𝑖≥1mi≥1) comes first, denoting the number of colors in the palette of the 𝑖i-th scene. Then 𝑚𝑖mi distinct integers 𝑎𝑖,1,𝑎𝑖,2,…,𝑎𝑖,𝑚𝑖ai,1,ai,2,…,ai,mi (0≤𝑎𝑖,𝑗≤1090≤ai,j≤109) follow, each identifying a color in the palette.

It is guaranteed that the sum of 𝑚𝑖mi over 𝑖=1,2,…,𝑛i=1,2,…,n does not exceed 2×1052×105.

## Output

In the first line, output an integer indicating the maximum attainable number of transitions among all arrangements of scenes.

In the second line, output a permutation 𝑝1,𝑝2,…,𝑝𝑛p1,p2,…,pn denoting that the 𝑝𝑖pi-th scene is played during the 𝑖i-th period of time in chronological order. Your construction should maximize the number of transitions. If there are multiple arrangements of scenes that maximize the number of transitions, you may choose any to output its corresponding permutation.

## Note

In the first sample case, scene 44 to scene 22, scene 22 to scene 33, scene 11 to scene 55 can all contribute a transition.

In the second sample case, no scenes share the common color. Thus, any permutation of length 33 will be acceptable.
statementZhMd:
来自中国各地的朋友们，欢迎来到沈阳！作为出题人，我们与全体工作人员一道，十分荣幸地迎接各位来到这里，享受这场精心筹备的赛事，并共同见证东北大学（NEU）连续第九年举办 ICPC 沈阳区域赛。

过去几年，对大多数人而言都充满挑战。人类社会经历了新冠疫情，但我们与之抗争，并取得了胜利。当某些人的心智似乎被午夜嚎叫侵蚀时，人类仍在经受考验。而我们此刻所在的这所可爱的大学，刚刚圆满结束了百年校庆，为下一个百年翻开了新的篇章。这些便是我们为这道序章题命名的灵感来源。我们衷心希望，每个人都能为梦想不懈奋斗，而非甘愿成为时代的眼泪。我们也希望，每个人都能用新时代的技术治愈世界，而非将我们的文明引向日暮！

作为东北大学百年校庆的重要组成部分，无人机表演以缤纷色彩点亮夜空，绘就了一幅幅令人惊叹的空中画作。在这道序章题中，你将遇到一个与之相关、看似 NP-hard 的任务。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1c85a967bb6d024ad1abc1fb3c59f98f15884192.png) 东北大学无人机表演

假设无人机表演共有 𝑛n 个场景。每个场景的配色可以用一个整数集合来描述，其中不同的整数代表不同的颜色。我们称一个场景配色中对应整数最大的颜色为该场景的*主色*。

无人机操作员打算安排这些场景的播放顺序。重新排序后，对于每一对**相邻**的场景，如果前一个场景的主色出现在后一个场景的配色中，就会产生一次*转场*。你能否帮助构造一种场景排列，使转场次数尽可能多？

形式化地，设 𝑆𝑖Si 为描述第 𝑖i 个场景配色的整数集合。你需要构造一个排列 𝑝1,𝑝2,…,𝑝𝑛p1,p2,…,pn，使得 ∑𝑛−1𝑖=1[max{𝑆𝑝𝑖}∈𝑆𝑝𝑖+1]∑i=1n−1[max{Spi}∈Spi+1] 在所有长度为 𝑛n 的排列中最大，其中，当 max{𝑆𝑝𝑖}∈𝑆𝑝𝑖+1max{Spi}∈Spi+1 时，[max{𝑆𝑝𝑖}∈𝑆𝑝𝑖+1][max{Spi}∈Spi+1] 的值为 11；当 max{𝑆𝑝𝑖}∉𝑆𝑝𝑖+1max{Spi}∉Spi+1 时，其值为 00。

回顾一下，长度为 𝑛n 的排列是一个由 𝑛n 个整数组成的序列，其中从 11 到 𝑛n 的每个整数都恰好出现一次。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 𝑛n（2≤𝑛≤1052≤n≤105），表示无人机表演中的场景数量。

接下来的 𝑛n 行中，第 𝑖i 行首先包含一个整数 𝑚𝑖mi（𝑚𝑖≥1mi≥1），表示第 𝑖i 个场景配色中的颜色数量。随后是 𝑚𝑖mi 个互不相同的整数 𝑎𝑖,1,𝑎𝑖,2,…,𝑎𝑖,𝑚𝑖ai,1,ai,2,…,ai,mi（0≤𝑎𝑖,𝑗≤1090≤ai,j≤109），每个整数代表配色中的一种颜色。

保证 𝑖=1,2,…,𝑛i=1,2,…,n 对应的所有 𝑚𝑖mi 之和不超过 2×1052×105。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数，表示所有场景排列中能够达到的最大转场次数。

第二行输出一个排列 𝑝1,𝑝2,…,𝑝𝑛p1,p2,…,pn，表示按时间先后顺序，第 𝑖i 个时段播放第 𝑝𝑖pi 个场景。你的构造应使转场次数最大。如果有多种场景排列都能达到最大转场次数，你可以任选一种，输出其对应的排列。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，从场景 44 到场景 22、从场景 22 到场景 33，以及从场景 11 到场景 55，都可以产生一次转场。

在第二个样例中，任意两个场景都没有共同的颜色。因此，任意长度为 33 的排列均可。
